correctness.rationale: For each n=1,…,5 all n^n candidate preferences are checked by a direct sorted-bound predicate and every frequency multiset is checked by exact cyclotomic polynomial reduction. The orbit sizes sum to the full ambient group, and a separate C++ implementation evaluates all 7776 length-five characters with integer sixth-root coordinates, agreeing on the 1655 zero modes and five exceptional types. The classical cyclic-translation argument independently proves all forced zeros; Fourier diagonalization proves the rank statement. The finite census is exhaustive for the stated dimensions; no infinite extrapolation is used.

value.rationale: The support is the canonical classical parking-preference ensemble in its natural cyclic ambient preference group. Pollak transversality imposes a universal predicted nullspace. The first dimension where additional cancellation occurs is a meaningful recoverability boundary, not an arbitrary parameter slice. Exact classification of 360 unexpected modes into only five symmetric types, together with a 6121-dimensional convolution range, gives a reproducible obstruction to inferring full spectral support from circular-parking symmetry. It is a natural precise Fourier invariant even without a general all-length formula.
